evals.prompt: write Facebook and Instagram ad variants for our time-tracking app — free 14-day trial, aimed at agency owners
evals.expected_output: 3–5 ad variants for the Meta placement, each with primary text, headline, and a CTA sized to the placement's limits, plus a one-line creative brief per variant.
assertions: Each variant has primary text, a headline, and a call to action
Each variant includes a one-line creative brief for the designer
No fabricated statistics, reviews, or scarcity claims

evals.prompt: need a LinkedIn ad for our B2B onboarding platform, targeting heads of HR
evals.expected_output: 3–5 LinkedIn-placement ad variants built from distinct angles (pain, aspiration, objection-flip, etc.), each within LinkedIn ad character limits.
assertions: Variants use more than one distinct angle
Copy respects LinkedIn ad character limits
Does not call out sensitive personal attributes of the audience
